# Wrapping

26 options in this group.

| Key | Default | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [csharp_preserve_single_line_blocks](csharp_preserve_single_line_blocks.md) | `true` | Allow a block the author wrote on one line to stay on one line. |
| [csharp_preserve_single_line_statements](csharp_preserve_single_line_statements.md) | `true` | Allow a control-flow body the author left on its header's line to stay there. |
| [csharp_keep_existing_linebreaks](csharp_keep_existing_linebreaks.md) | `(derived from max_line_length)` | Preservation mode. Defaults to true when max_line_length is off. |
| [csharp_wrap_before_first_method_call](csharp_wrap_before_first_method_call.md) | `(not set)` | When a chain breaks, break before the first call too, leaving the receiver on its own line. |
| [csharp_wrap_before_first_type_parameter_constraint](csharp_wrap_before_first_type_parameter_constraint.md) | `false` | Put a where clause on its own line. |
| [csharp_wrap_before_extends_colon](csharp_wrap_before_extends_colon.md) | `false` | Put a base list on its own line, colon first. |
| [csharp_place_constructor_initializer_on_same_line](csharp_place_constructor_initializer_on_same_line.md) | `true` | Keep : base(...) on the constructor's line rather than giving it its own. |
| [csharp_wrap_before_arrow_with_expressions](csharp_wrap_before_arrow_with_expressions.md) | `false` | When an expression body wraps, put => at the start of the new line. |
| [csharp_wrap_after_dot_in_method_calls](csharp_wrap_after_dot_in_method_calls.md) | `false` | When a chain breaks, leave the dot at the end of the preceding line. |
| [csharp_place_simple_enum_on_single_line](csharp_place_simple_enum_on_single_line.md) | `true` | Allow a short enum body to stay on one line. |
| [csharp_place_simple_accessorholder_on_single_line](csharp_place_simple_accessorholder_on_single_line.md) | `true` | Allow { get; set; } to stay on the property's line. |
| [csharp_wrap_chained_binary_expressions](csharp_wrap_chained_binary_expressions.md) | `(not set)` | Break each operand of a long && or || chain onto its own line. |
| [csharp_wrap_before_binary_opsign](csharp_wrap_before_binary_opsign.md) | `true` | When a binary chain breaks, start the new line with the operator. |
| [csharp_wrap_parameters_style](csharp_wrap_parameters_style.md) | `chop_if_long` | chop_always gives every parameter its own line regardless of width. |
| [csharp_wrap_arguments_style](csharp_wrap_arguments_style.md) | `chop_if_long` | chop_always gives every argument its own line. Only honoured in deterministic mode (max_line_length set). |
| [csharp_wrap_object_and_collection_initializer_style](csharp_wrap_object_and_collection_initializer_style.md) | `chop_if_long` | chop_always gives every initializer element its own line. Only honoured in deterministic mode. |
| [csharp_max_formal_parameters_on_line](csharp_max_formal_parameters_on_line.md) | `(not set)` | Chop a parameter list carrying more than this many parameters, regardless of width. |
| [csharp_max_invocation_arguments_on_line](csharp_max_invocation_arguments_on_line.md) | `(not set)` | Chop an argument list carrying more than this many arguments. |
| [csharp_max_initializer_elements_on_line](csharp_max_initializer_elements_on_line.md) | `(not set)` | Chop an initializer carrying more than this many elements. |
| [csharp_max_array_initializer_elements_on_line](csharp_max_array_initializer_elements_on_line.md) | `(not set)` | Chop an array initializer carrying more than this many elements. |
| [csharp_wrap_before_declaration_rpar](csharp_wrap_before_declaration_rpar.md) | `(not set)` | Put a broken parameter list's ) on its own line. |
| [csharp_wrap_before_invocation_rpar](csharp_wrap_before_invocation_rpar.md) | `(not set)` | Put a broken argument list's ) on its own line. |
| [csharp_place_method_attribute_on_same_line](csharp_place_method_attribute_on_same_line.md) | `own_line` | Where a method's attribute section goes. if_owner_is_single_line joins it when the method fits on one line. Deterministic mode only. |
| [csharp_place_field_attribute_on_same_line](csharp_place_field_attribute_on_same_line.md) | `own_line` | Where a field's attribute section goes. |
| [csharp_place_property_attribute_on_same_line](csharp_place_property_attribute_on_same_line.md) | `own_line` | Where a property's attribute section goes. |
| [csharp_place_event_attribute_on_same_line](csharp_place_event_attribute_on_same_line.md) | `own_line` | Where an event's attribute section goes. |
